assets.prompt: Production game sprite sheet, exactly EIGHT ROWS and EIGHT COLUMNS, 64 whole-body pixel-art figures on a truly transparent background. One character identity only, matching the supplied reference. Fixed orthographic top-down RPG camera, consistent native pixel clusters, sharp edges, restrained palette. No text, captions, grid lines, scenery, ground shadows, detached particles or attack VFX. Generous transparent gutters between every cell, no limbs crossing cell borders. In each row, columns 1-4 are four distinct walking poses (left foot forward, passing, right foot forward, passing), columns 5-8 are four attack poses (windup, release/strike, follow-through, neutral recovery). Walking rows loop smoothly, attacks are one-shot. Stable body scale, head size and foot anchor across all 64 poses. Exact row directions from top to bottom: 1 SOUTH front facing viewer; 2 SOUTHWEST down-left with face visible; 3 WEST left profile, toes and nose LEFT; 4 NORTHWEST up-left, back of torso and left cheek; 5 NORTH back facing away, no face; 6 NORTHEAST up-right, back and right cheek; 7 EAST right profile, toes and nose RIGHT; 8 SOUTHEAST down-right with face visible. All attacks must point along the row direction; WEST attacks LEFT, NORTHWEST attacks UP-LEFT. Do not turn the character around during a strike. Back views show the back of head and clothing. Preserve the reference character's face, hair, outfit, colors and accessories. Do not redesign costumes or substitute another person. Keep two eyes in front/diagonal-front views and at most one eye in profile. Adult male Edelzio exactly as reference: short dark brown hair, thin rectangular dark glasses, small moustache and pointed goatee, brown polo shirt, dark charcoal pants, dark blue sneakers with pale soles, gray backpack with gray shoulder straps. Attack is a bare-fist punch, no weapon. Maintain his older adult face, not a teenager. Backpack remains gray and visible from rear/side, straps in front.
